verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt served with HTTP 200 at salesforce.com/llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed at a vendor-published llms.txt index. However, the sampled content indexes marketing and training pages such as the AI Agent Course rather than Sales Cloud developer or API docs. Missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt covers Sales Cloud product and API documentation, any agent-oriented docs (e.g. llms-full.txt or markdown doc variants), first-party documentation of the llms.txt, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
